Chapter 853: Chapter 3: Opening the Path, Dominating, Chaos (Please Subscribe)

“With my current physical body, soul, and the world within me…”

“It is conceivable to barely bear the will of the mind.”

On the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, thinking to himself.

At Level Ten, the will index of the mind reached more than 33.3 million points.

Such a terrifying will of the mind, measured on a Level Ten life… it’s like pouring one hundred or a thousand cups of water into a single cup.

The cup cannot bear so much water and will naturally overflow.

This was also the reason why Xia Qin, a supreme fighter, recognized at first glance that Lin Yuan’s mental will was excessive.

Logically, the higher the mental will, the harder it should be for others to detect.

After all, the power of such mental layers is best at concealing itself.

But now, after stepping into Level Eleven, Lin Yuan had undergone a transformation, significantly enhancing his physical body, soul, and inner world.

Although still unable to match the mental will index of over 33 million points.

It is much better than during Level Ten, at least under concealment, it can deceive the perception of Level Twelve supreme fighters.

Between Level Twelve supreme fighters, they understand each other and disdain to conceal their mental will, but Lin Yuan is not Level Twelve.

It doesn’t matter if his own human civilization’s supreme fighters see through him, but it is not good if those supreme fighters from other races notice Lin Yuan’s strong mental will.

After all, it’s best to keep one’s trump cards hidden.

Lin Yuan’s announcement of stepping into Level Eleven was also in preparation for entering the super-sized battlefield.

And merely announcing the entrance to Level Eleven? That hardly counts as revealing his trump cards, for Lin Yuan’s real strength is far beyond the Perfect Level Eleven.

“The super-sized battlefield will be established within half a year.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself; the timing of the sup-sized battlefield’s creation is scarcely known among human civilization’s evolvers, but Lin Yuan got explicit information from the supreme fighters.

“Two Primordial Spirits…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred, his powerful mental will allowed one of his incarnations to defend itself on the large battlefields.

Currently on the large battlefield to expedite the accumulation of World-Breaking Origin Force is just one of Lin Yuan’s incarnations, which frees up a Primordial Spirit indeed.

“It’s a pity that the Primordial Spirit is ultimately a Primordial Spirit, the Chaos Void Origin, all immersed in the depths of my true body’s inner world…” Lin Yuan slightly shook his head.

Although the will of the true body’s Primordial Spirit is shared, in the case of the Chaos Void Origin’s arrival, there are some differences, at least the origin infusion onto the two Primordial Spirits isn’t on the same level as the true body.

Simply put, the Chaos Void Origin infused in the two Primordial Spirits is far less than that in the true self.

“But this is also good.”

Lin Yuan changed his thoughts, his eyes relaxed.

If the two Primordial Spirits were like the true self, immersed with a large amount of Chaos Void Origin in their inner worlds.

Then Lin Yuan would really be reluctant to deploy the Primordial Spirits. Once a Primordial Spirit perishes, the immersed massive Chaos Void Origin would also dissipate.

Now for Lin Yuan, to recondense two Primordial Spirits indeed requires some cost, but just a little, completely bearable.

“With my current level and realm, I can start cultivating the Martial Tao Level Eleven Chapter.”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was profound.

Compared to Lin Yuan’s own cultivation path, the Martial Tao Level Eleven Chapter is as smooth as can be.

After all, many of Lin Yuan’s conditions cannot be replicated, understanding rules in various other dimensional spaces? The Against-Heaven’s Understanding that leaps to conclusions?

…

“Um?”

“Nalan is looking for me?”

Lin Yuan’s mind moved, his consciousness entered the Virtual World.

“Congratulations Galaxy Master…” Nalan appeared, his gaze towards Lin Yuan mixed with complex emotions.

Compared to other evolvers who only heard about the feats of the Galaxy Master, over many many years of breakthrough…

Nalan witnessed the growth of Lin Yuan firsthand.

Nalan remembered the first time he met the Galaxy Master was on the Chikun Main Star, tasked by the supreme fighter Xia Qin to deliver the Soul-Settling Pearl.

Back then, how naive was Lin Yuan? Although showing remarkable talent and aptitude in the Chikun Star Domain, viewed across the entire human civilization, still quite inconspicuous.

Yet, when Nalan later paid attention to Lin Yuan, the latter was already Level Nine, and under the request of a supreme fighter, the two engaged in a sparring over the Rule of Time.

Nalan lost miserably in that spar.

There was absolutely no suspense in his defeat.

Because of this crushing defeat, Nalan broke through his shackles and stepped into Level Eleven.

But now?

How long has it passed?

Lin Yuan had also stepped into Level Eleven?

Nalan’s thoughts were myriad, not feeling any envy whatsoever, because he simply couldn’t afford to feel envious.

Other evolvers only learned from various reports about the growth rate of the Galaxy Master, while Nalan watched Lin Yuan grow with his own eyes.

The shock brought to oneself by the two is entirely different.

“It’s just luck,” Lin Yuan waved his hand.

“You are being humble, Galaxy Master,” Nalan sighed.

“This time, I came to invite the Galaxy Master to participate in a gathering…” Nalan got to the point.

This gathering, formed by many Level Eleven evolvers from human civilization, is specifically to celebrate Lin Yuan stepping into Level Eleven.

Even in a peak group like human civilization, Level Eleven evolvers are extremely rare, visibly totaling less than a thousand.

Any time a Level Eleven evolver is born, there will be a meeting among other Level Eleven evolvers, especially for someone like Lin Yuan who ascended from the strongest Level Ten, the historically most genius evolver of human civilization.
